releaseNotesLines: Is update mein kya naya hai:
1) Cash + Bank report mein ab din ke baqi vouchers bhi dekh sakte hain.
- "Show Other Vouchers" tick karein to cash/bank ke neeche wo vouchers aate hain jin mein cash ya bank nahi hua.
- Ye Voucher Type ya Created By ke hisab se group hote hain, aur har voucher ki detail nazar aati hai.
- Debit Credit voucher mein dono party ke naam nazar aate hain.
2) Cash + Bank report khulte hi apka apna cash account aur uske saath wale users select hote hain.
- Select All / Unselect All ka option bhi hai, Excel ki tarah.

4) Purani ya agli tarikh mein entry karne par ab rok diya jata hai (server ki tarikh ke mutabiq).
releaseNotes:
Is update mein kya naya hai:

1) Cash + Bank report mein ab din ke baqi vouchers bhi dekh sakte hain.
   - "Show Other Vouchers" tick karein to cash/bank ke neeche wo vouchers aate hain jin mein cash ya bank nahi hua.
   - Ye Voucher Type ya Created By ke hisab se group hote hain, aur har voucher ki detail nazar aati hai.
   - Debit Credit voucher mein dono party ke naam nazar aate hain.

2) Cash + Bank report khulte hi apka apna cash account aur uske saath wale users select hote hain.
   - Select All / Unselect All ka option bhi hai, Excel ki tarah.
   - Cashbook mein hamesha sab users ki entries aati hain, taake closing sahi rahe.

3) Aik din ki report mein Date column nahi aata, date upar likhi hoti hai. Figures poore rupay mein dikhte hain.

4) Purani ya agli tarikh mein entry karne par ab rok diya jata hai (server ki tarikh ke mutabiq).

Update Date: 27-10-2026
